answer: Give each agent one passport, checked in person. The agent types its passport number, and the system checks it against the immigration list. Then the agent visits an immigration office, shows the jade-green booklet, and an officer takes a photo and fingerprints and stamps a one-time code. That stamp is the signal that a real person stood in the room, and a thread runs from the code back to the passport number, so one person cannot open a second agent. Each fake costs about 5 plus half a day of travel, so 100 fakes cost ,500 and 100 office visits.
